text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH: 5xx spike and latency increase on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (since 3139996900). Error rate 12% -> paging oncall-alex.
oncall-alex: acked. looking. pulling up dashboards.
sre-sahil: i'm seeing a sudden jump in 500s that correspond to 'incompatible payload' errors from the inference gateway — stack shows chat/instruct runtime rejecting embedding requests. full trace -> `TypeError: input not vectorizable` in runtime-adapter.
prod-eng-maria: wait, did the model-family alias update from the canary this morning land? release pipeline showed alias swap for model-unified:1.4 -> model-unified:stable at 3139996880.
oncall-alex: oh. if alias now points embeddings traffic to an 'instruct' variant, fallback routing might be mapping to an incompatible variant.
devin-debug: confirm in routing table: `alias:model-unified -> variant:instruct-v1` (tag: instruct), expected `variant:embed-v1` (tag: embeddings). This was part of the canary deploy script (deploy-swap-alias.sh).
prod-eng-maria: I pushed that canary. I thought the tag mapping was preserved but pipeline had a new default that prefers the latest variant regardless of interface. my bad — rolling back now.
incident-bot: action_required: apply rollback alias to model-unified@embed-v1 for eu-west-1.
oncall-alex: maria, please run the rollback. I'll put a quick mitigation: disable cross-interface fallback for embeddings on the router.
prod-eng-maria: running rollback: ```
# rollback alias to embed variant
redwoodctl alias set model-unified --variant embed-v1 --region eu-west-1 --force
```
prod-eng-maria: done. alias now points to embed-v1. returning to health checks.
incident-bot: Metric: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 1.1% within 60s after alias rollback. Latency back to baseline.
sre-sahil: warmup note: a subset of requests still routed to instruct due to in-flight cached routes and KV cache TTL (2m). we're seeing residual errors until caches evict.
oncall-alex: mitigation checklist: 1) rollback alias (done) 2) disable instruct variant fallback for embeddings in region (in progress) 3) run ingest-retry for failed embedding requests (postmortem) 4) notify impacted customers.
katie-ops: i'll file incident ticket and notify CS. Lia, can you triage customer impact?
cs-lia: pinging support queue. early signal: 7 customers reported degraded search embeddings (some saw missing results; ticket ids: SUP-9981, SUP-9983). one internal partner (content-indexer) hit 502s and retried. opening incident-impact sheet.
prod-eng-maria: also found root cause in deploy pipeline: `deploy-swap-alias.sh` logic picks latest variant matching family but ignores `interface` tag unless `--preserve-interface` flag is set. we didn't set it for this canary. patching pipeline now.
devin-debug: recommend immediate guard: set router to treat alias updates as atomic with interface check. also add automated check that alias->variant.interface == required_interface for important endpoints (embeddings, chat, rerank).
oncall-alex: can we temporarily set a routing policy to disallow fallback from embeddings -> any instruct/chat variant?
sre-sahil: yes: ```
# disable cross-interface fallback for embeddings
redwoodctl routing policy update --endpoint /v1/embeddings --region eu-west-1 --no-cross-interface-fallback true
```
sre-sahil: policy applied. observing zero more new incompatible errors.
incident-bot: note: alert muted for 15m while teams validate.
cs-lia: preliminary impact estimate: ~12 customers affected, ~9k embedding requests failed during window (3139996880-3139996960). major customers: acme-search (ticket SUP-9984) saw ~30% embedding failure during their peak.
prod-eng-maria: created PR to add `--preserve-interface` to the deploy pipeline and a CI check that verifies alias compatibility. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pipelines/pull/4523
oncall-alex: handoff incoming: i'm heading off shift in 10m. passing to SRE day crew. sahil, can you take lead for follow-up? make sure retries/backfills are scheduled for customer-impacting failures.
sre-sahil: taking lead. immediate next steps: - monitor residual errors until TTL clears - run a bounded retry script for upstream customers (coordinate with CS) - postmortem with RCA, timeline, and deploy script fix.
katie-ops: I'll coordinate a customer communication draft with Lia. recommend telling customers we rolled back alias and are scheduling re-ingestion for failed vectors; ETA: 6 hours for backfill for high priority customers.
cs-lia: Customer note draft: "We experienced an elevated error rate for embeddings in eu-west-1 due to an alias configuration change during a canary promotion. We rolled the alias back and expect service to be fully recovered. We're scheduling vector re-ingestion for affected customers. Contact support for priority handling."
devin-debug: follow-up ops item: add a router-level lint that rejects alias swaps if interface tags don't match for endpoints with strict interface expectations (embeddings/chat). I'll own that ticket.
prod-eng-maria: adding postmortem owner: maria. timeline: will draft and attach deploy logs, alias history, and the rollback commands.
sre-sahil: leaving a runbook update: incident type = alias-interface-mismatch; mitigation steps + quick commands.
oncall-alex: thanks team. I leave the incident open for postmortem and customer outreach. Leaving note: handoff to sahil at 3139997140.
sre-sahil: acknowledged handoff. i will keep channel updated. closing pager: :white_check_mark: 3139997180
